title: Pressurized intraperitoneal aerosol chemotherapy (PIPAC) in multimodal therapy for patients with oligometastatic peritoneal gastric cancer: a randomized multicenter phase III trial. PIPAC_VEROne
official: Pressurized intraperitoneal aerosol chemotherapy (PIPAC) in multimodal therapy for patients with oligometastatic peritoneal gastric cancer: a randomized multicenter phase III trial. PIPAC_VEROne
summary:
Main objective: To evaluate whether the association of PIPAC with chemotherapy compared to chemotherapy alone increases the
percentage of patients who undergo surgery with radical intent (CRS and HIPEC).
To evaluate whether the association of PIPAC with chemotherapy compared to chemotherapy alone increases the
progression-free survival (PFS).

interventions.name: OPDIVO 10 mg/mL concentrate for solution for infusion.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age between 18-75 years
2. Primary gastric adenocarcinoma of first diagnosis not previously treated
3. Laparoscopic finding of positive peritoneal cytology and / or peritoneal localizations of disease (PCI ≤ 6), confirmed by histological examination
4. Signature of informed consent
5. ECOG PS scale 0-1
6. Patients of childbearing potential will be included in the study and monitored by serum pregnancy tests before each chemotherapy cycle and each PIPAC and at the end of treatment. Oral contraceptives will not be used due to the already high thrombotic risk related to the disease, but all other contraceptives will be used according to CTFG indications on contraception.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Presence of extraperitoneal metastases
2. hypersensitivity to the active substances or to any of the excipients
3. liver failure (AST) / ALT> 3 times normal values, ALT> 3 times normal values, Bilirubin> 1.5 normal values)
4. Creatininemia> 1.25 mg / dL
5. • Ischemic / haemorrhagic stroke within the past 6 months • Acute myocardial infarction within the past 6 months • Moderate / severe heart failure (NYHA III-IV)
6. Leukopenia <2,000 / µl • Thrombocytopenia <100,000 / µl
7. Active hepatitis B or C
8. HIV infection
9. creatinine clearance less than 30ml / min
10. PCI> 6
11. Localization of the primary site of disease in the gastric esophagus junction of esophageal relevance (Siewert I-II)
12. Previous allergic reactions to cisplatin or doxorubicin
13. Haemorrhagic or occlusive manifestation of disease that candidates the patient for palliative surgery
14. ASA IV
15. Refusal of the patient to sign the consent
16. positive on diagnostic biopsies for EBV, MSI and HER2
17. pregnancy and breastfeeding
